profile.headline: SSR FullStack developer | Team lead | React | Nestjs | TS
profile.summary: I am a person with a high learning capacity and skills such as teamwork, leadership and good communication. I perform with responsibility and perseverance, I have the facility to establish good relationships while always working ethically and giving the best of my proactivity to individual achievement and team achievement.

positions.title: Software engineer
positions.locationName: Provincia de Buenos Aires, Argentina · Hybrid
positions.description:
Experience in designing and developing data-intensive applications, working with distributed systems, high concurrency, and large-scale data volumes.

Focus areas include:

Data modeling and technology selection with an emphasis on performance and scalability

Data replication, partitioning, and consistency, balancing latency and availability

Event-driven architectures and asynchronous processing to decouple and scale systems

Design of reliable, fault-tolerant, and observable systems, with monitoring of key metrics

Strong focus on performance optimization (latency, throughput, resource utilization) and continuous improvement driven by metrics.

Active collaboration with Product and UX teams, contributing to the definition of technical solutions aligned with business goals and user experience.

Applying principles of scalability, reliability, and maintainability in high-traffic production environments.
positions.insights: Skills: Amplitude Analytics · Go · Elasticsearch · Java · Datadog

positions.title: SSR Fullstack
positions.description:
- Development and optimization of applications using design patterns and scalable architectures such as CQRS.
- Implementation and design of microservices, ensuring modularity, scalability, and high availability.
- Development of interactive and responsive user interfaces with React, following best practices like component reusability and performance optimization.
- Pull Request (PR) reviews to ensure code quality, consistency, and maintainability.
- Management of relational and non-relational databases, optimizing queries and designing efficient data structures.
- Design and development of REST APIs to streamline integration between services.
- Participation in building scalable and robust backend architectures, integrated with microservices-based solutions.
- Automation and continuous deployment through Azure DevOps, managing tickets and pipelines.
- Close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, coordinating both backend and frontend development.

positions.title: SSR Fullstack developer
positions.description:
-Application análisis and development.
-Fluent communication with the client in order to identify their needs and requirements.
-Application performance, quality and responsiveness optimization.
-Development, maintenance and improvement of product funcionalities.
-Work together with backend developers to manage data.
-Creation of rest API'S.
-Design the structure for scalable backends.
-Develop of both front-end & back-end with Sockets service.
positions.insights: Skills: Redux · fullstack · Desarrollo de API · Bases de datos · Sockets · JavaScript · Desarrollo front end · NestJS · Desarrollo web back end · Node.js · Socket.io · TypeScript · React.js

positions.title: Fullstack developer
positions.description:
Communication with clients to understand their business needs and develop the systems/tools/pages that suits better. 
Development of indicators to measure product performance and detection of opportunities for improvement. 
Deployments of both frontend & backend apps.

positions.title: Account Executive - Technical Support
positions.description:
-First line corporate clients (Mining, transport of dangerous cargo and large cargo)
generators).
-Clients in LATAM.

positions.title: Técnico de instalación
positions.description:
-Responsible for providing technical and functional advice to customers.
-Carry out technical tasks related to the installation and use of TV and Internet services.
-Reception, coordination and management of customer orders.
-Daily inventory control of assigned equipment for facilities.
